name: Postmake

sources.title: Submit Your Business — Standard $79 / Premium $119 / Promoted $199 plus free badge option

conditions: Paid is the default: 'Getting listed is paid' — Standard $79, Premium $119, Promoted $199 (all permanent listings)
Free route exists via badge: add a Postmake badge to your site and they feature the listing once it's live (instructions at /submit-badge-listing)
requirements: Focus on business tools and services — manual review checks directory fit
Misfit paid submissions are cancelled and refunded
New submissions processed within 'a couple of business days'
preparation: Business/tool details and URL appropriate to the directory's categories (design, development, marketing, launch tools)
Badge embed for the free route, or a Stripe checkout payment for a paid listing ($79/$119/$199)
Newsletter-worthy angle — paid tiers promise a feature to 1,700+ subscribers
workflow: Choose free badge listing (/submit-badge-listing instructions) or a paid tier via Stripe buy links
Manual fit review — rejected paid submissions are refunded
Permanent listing goes live on a dedicated page linked across the directory; promoted tiers get 'What's New' featuring and 1 month of directory promotion
watchFor: The three paid tiers display identical bullet lists on the submit page — price ladder differences are not spelled out; assume escalating promotion
Free badge route exists but is buried at the bottom of the submit page — easy to miss
Backlinks cited as '45 DR' — modest authority
Some outbound links are affiliate links per the site's own footer
countsAsLive: Permanent dedicated listing page on postmake.io linked from the directory (and 'What's New' section for fresh/promoted listings)
unknowns: Concrete differences between Standard/Premium/Promoted tiers beyond the headline descriptions
Whether the free badge listing is dofollow and how quickly it is reviewed
Whether account creation is needed or submission is email/form-based
